en: Close-up of a yellow and black postage stamp affixed to a postcard. The stamp shows a shield with a stylized castle or city gate in the center, surrounded by a lattice pattern and decorative side panels with leaves and crescents. At the top is the inscription "EESTI POST" and on the right edge a small box with the year "1938". At the bottom is the word "CARITAS" above the denomination "50" appearing in two opposing corners, with a small cross emblem centered below.
